title: BBVA helps design a common protocol led by Sierra AI and Meta to connect AI agents with businesses
hook_text: Meta and Sierra AI launch protocol
script:
Meta and Sierra AI are launching a new protocol to standardize how AI agents interact with businesses.
Spanish bank BBVA is helping design this framework to improve how digital agents function.
The goal is to allow AI to perform complex actions across different corporate platforms.
BBVA aims to use this to better integrate AI into its existing banking services.
The protocol focuses on technical interoperability, allowing agents to execute tasks across disparate corporate systems.
Would you trust an AI agent to manage your banking transactions?
